notes: What display-mode needs from the application component that provides the configuration (no component of the standard 39 provides this type; the recipe's own application component does). Values are passed as arguments to createMode. Persistence and authentication belong to the application.

fields.initial: 'player' or 'board' (SessionMode): the mode a session starts in
fields.eventName: nonempty string, for example app:mode: the browser event published on each mode change; the same name goes to video-calls and windows-desktop (modeEvent)
